## [OVERVIEW]

Medusa v2 plugin that extends the native promotion system in three ways: (1) cart-state eligibility rules — subtotal thresholds, item quantities, per-customer usage caps, first-order checks — evaluated dynamically as the cart changes; (2) promotion modes — bundle pricing ("3 for 50") and repeating buy-get deals ("buy 2 get 1 free, every group") that Medusa's one-shot engine cannot express; (3) manual cart adjustments — operator-created discounts/surcharges per cart.

Enforcement uses a three-layer architecture: Layer 1 (Code Gate) validates synchronously when a promo code is entered, Layer 2 (Auto-Apply Engine) runs asynchronously on cart.updated to add/remove promotions, Layer 3 (Checkout Gate) blocks order placement if any promotion violates its rules.

All plugin-managed promotions must have `is_automatic: false` in Medusa. The plugin owns auto-apply logic via Layer 2.

Four DB tables: `promotion_ext_config`, `promotion_ext_rule_group`, `promotion_ext_rule`, `cart_ext_adjustment`. Admin widget injected at `promotion.details.after`.

## [INSTALL]

Requires: Node.js 20+, @medusajs/medusa 2.15.2, PostgreSQL

```bash
yarn add @retailos-ai/rms-promotions-extension
```

Register in `medusa-config.ts`:
```ts
import { defineConfig } from "@medusajs/framework/utils"
export default defineConfig({
  plugins: [
    { resolve: "@retailos-ai/rms-promotions-extension" },
  ],
})
```

Run migrations:
```bash
npx medusa db:migrate
```

## [QUICKSTART]

```bash
# 1. Create promotion in Medusa admin with is_automatic: false

# 2. Create config with auto-apply
curl -X POST /admin/promotion-ext-configs \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer <token>" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{ "promotion_id": "promo_abc", "auto_apply": true }'

# 3. Create include rule group
curl -X POST /admin/promotion-ext-rule-groups \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer <token>" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{ "promotion_config_id": "pec_001", "type": "include" }'

# 4. Add rule: apply when subtotal >= 300
curl -X POST /admin/promotion-ext-rules \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer <token>" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{ "rule_group_id": "perg_001", "rule_type": "comparison", "config": { "field": "subtotal", "operator": "gte", "value": 300 } }'
```
Promotion auto-applies to carts with subtotal >= 300, auto-removes when below.

## [USAGE]

### Rule Fields

| Field | Type | Operators | Scope | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| subtotal | number | eq neq gt gte lt lte | -- | Cart item subtotal pre-discount |
| totalQuantity | number | eq neq gt gte lt lte | -- | Total items in cart |
| quantityOfProduct | number | eq neq gt gte lt lte | { product_id } | Qty of specific product |
| quantityOfCollection | number | eq neq gt gte lt lte | { collection_id } | Qty from specific collection |
| usesPerCustomer | number | lt lte | -- | Times customer used this promotion |
| firstOrder | boolean | eq | -- | Customer has zero prior non-cancelled orders |

Guest carts pass usesPerCustomer and firstOrder unconditionally (optimistic).

### Combinators

rules_combinator on group: "and"|"or" (default "and") — joins rules within a group
include_groups_combinator on config: "and"|"or" (default "or") — joins groups
Defaults produce DNF (Disjunctive Normal Form).

### Auto-Apply vs Code-Only

auto_apply: true — Layer 2 subscriber adds/removes promotion on cart changes
auto_apply: false (default) — code-only, rules enforced on code entry

### Promotion Modes

promotion_mode on PromotionExtConfig controls how discounts are calculated. Non-standard modes reuse Medusa's application_method fields:

| Field | Standard | Bundle | Buy-Get Repeat |
|---|---|---|---|
| type | fixed/percentage | Must be "fixed" | Discount type |
| value | Discount amount/% | Bundle target price | Discount on "get" items |
| max_quantity | Max items discounted | Max participating items (complete bundles only) | Max "buy" items (cycles = floor(max_quantity / buy_quantity)) |

#### Bundle
Fixed price for N qualifying items, repeating. Example: "3 for 50".
Requirements: Medusa promotion "Amount off products" (type: "fixed", target_type: "items")
application_method.value = bundle target price
mode_config = { bundle_size: number, remainder: "full_price" }

```bash
curl -X PATCH /admin/promotion-ext-configs/:id \
  -d '{ "promotion_mode": "bundle", "mode_config": { "bundle_size": 3, "remainder": "full_price" } }'
```

#### Buy-Get Repeat
Buy X at full price, get Y discounted, repeating. Example: "buy 2 get 1 free".
Requirements: product-level type (target_type: "items")
application_method.type = "fixed"|"percentage", application_method.value = discount
mode_config = { buy_quantity: number, get_quantity: number, discount_target: "cheapest", remainder: "full_price" }

```bash
curl -X PATCH /admin/promotion-ext-configs/:id \
  -d '{ "promotion_mode": "buyget_repeat", "mode_config": { "buy_quantity": 2, "get_quantity": 1, "discount_target": "cheapest", "remainder": "full_price" } }'
```

Discount applies to cheapest qualifying items. Remainder items at full price.
max_quantity on application_method caps participating items for bundle (only complete bundles form) or "buy" items for buy-get (cycles = floor(max_quantity / buy_quantity)). Note: for buy-get, this counts buy items not discounted items — deliberate business decision diverging from Medusa's native interpretation.

#### Promotion Type Constraints (validated on create/update)
Bundle requires type: "fixed" + target_type: "items"
Buy-get requires target_type: "items" (fixed or percentage)
"Amount off order", "Buy X Get Y", "Free shipping" are incompatible

### Manual Cart Adjustments

Operator-created discounts/surcharges per cart. Source: "manual".

```bash
# Item-level discount
curl -X POST /admin/cart-adjustments/:cart_id \
  -d '{ "item_id": "item_abc", "amount": 500, "code": "VIP", "description": "VIP discount" }'

# Cart-wide discount (spread proportionally across items)
curl -X POST /admin/cart-adjustments/:cart_id \
  -d '{ "amount": 1000, "code": "MANUAL", "description": "Store credit" }'
```

Positive amount = discount, negative = surcharge.
Cart-wide adjustments (item_id: null) spread proportionally by item subtotal share.

### Three-Layer Enforcement

| Layer | When | Mechanism | On Failure |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1 Code Gate | Promo code entered | updateCartPromotionsWorkflow.hooks.validate (sync) | HTTP 400 |
| 2 Auto-Apply | Cart mutation | cart.updated subscriber (async) | Silent add/remove |
| 3 Checkout | Order placement | completeCartWorkflow.hooks.validate (sync) | HTTP 400 |

### Adjustment Stripping

For non-standard modes, Medusa's computeActions still runs and produces adjustments from the application_method fields. The subscriber strips all Medusa-generated adjustments for these promotions (matched by promotion_id) and replaces them with the plugin's computed adjustments. This stripping is unconditional for any promotion with promotion_mode !== "standard".

## [IMPLEMENT]

### Adding cart-state rules to a Medusa promotion

When to use: you want a promotion to activate/deactivate based on live cart state (subtotal, quantities, customer history)

Prerequisites:
- Medusa promotion exists with is_automatic: false
- Plugin installed and migrations run

```ts
// In your admin panel or backend script:
const sdk = /* your Medusa admin SDK instance */

// 1. Create config
const { promotion_ext_config: config } = await sdk.client.fetch(
  "/admin/promotion-ext-configs",
  { method: "POST", body: { promotion_id: "promo_abc", auto_apply: true } }
)

// 2. Create rule group
const { promotion_ext_rule_group: group } = await sdk.client.fetch(
  "/admin/promotion-ext-rule-groups",
  { method: "POST", body: { promotion_config_id: config.id, type: "include", rules_combinator: "and" } }
)

// 3. Create rules: subtotal >= 200 AND totalQuantity >= 3
await sdk.client.fetch("/admin/promotion-ext-rules/batch", {
  method: "POST",
  body: {
    items: [
      { rule_group_id: group.id, rule_type: "comparison", config: { field: "subtotal", operator: "gte", value: 200 } },
      { rule_group_id: group.id, rule_type: "comparison", config: { field: "totalQuantity", operator: "gte", value: 3 } },
    ]
  }
})
```

### Setting up bundle pricing

When to use: "3 for 50" style promotions where N items have a fixed combined price

Prerequisites:
- Medusa promotion created as "Amount off products" (type: "fixed", target_type: "items")
- application_method.value set to the bundle price (e.g. 5000 for 50.00 in cents)
- application_method.max_quantity set if you want to cap participating items (optional, only complete bundles form)
- target_rules configured for which products qualify

```ts
// After creating the promotion in Medusa with type: "fixed", value: 5000
await sdk.client.fetch("/admin/promotion-ext-configs", {
  method: "POST",
  body: {
    promotion_id: "promo_bundle",
    auto_apply: true,
    promotion_mode: "bundle",
    mode_config: { bundle_size: 3, remainder: "full_price" }
  }
})
```

The calculator expands all eligible items into individual units, forms complete bundles of `bundle_size`, computes savings (original total - bundles * bundle_price), and distributes savings proportionally by unit price. Remainder items pay full price.

### Setting up buy-get repeat

When to use: "buy 2 get 1 free" or "buy 3 get 1 at 50% off" repeating for every qualifying group

Prerequisites:
- Medusa promotion created as product-level type (target_type: "items")
- application_method.type = "percentage" or "fixed"
- application_method.value = discount (e.g. 100 for 100% off = free, 50 for 50% off)
- application_method.max_quantity set to cap "buy" items (cycles = floor(max_quantity / buy_quantity), optional)

```ts
await sdk.client.fetch("/admin/promotion-ext-configs", {
  method: "POST",
  body: {
    promotion_id: "promo_buyget",
    auto_apply: true,
    promotion_mode: "buyget_repeat",
    mode_config: {
      buy_quantity: 2,
      get_quantity: 1,
      discount_target: "cheapest",
      remainder: "full_price"
    }
  }
})
```

Items are sorted by price ascending. In each group, the cheapest get_quantity items receive the discount. For percentage: discount = floor(unit_price * value / 100). For fixed: discount = min(value, unit_price).

### Creating manual cart adjustments from storefront server

When to use: operator needs to apply a custom discount/surcharge to a specific cart

Prerequisites:
- Admin API access (secret token or admin session)
- Cart ID known

```ts
// In your storefront server route handler:
const response = await fetch(`${MEDUSA_URL}/admin/cart-adjustments/${cartId}`, {
  method: "POST",
  headers: {
    "Authorization": `Bearer ${ADMIN_TOKEN}`,
    "Content-Type": "application/json",
  },
  body: JSON.stringify({
    amount: 1000,           // positive = discount
    code: "OPERATOR_DISC",
    description: "Loyalty discount",
    // item_id: "item_xyz"  // omit for cart-wide spread
  }),
})
```

Conventions:
- All admin endpoints require Medusa admin authentication
- No store-scoped adjustment endpoints exist -- customers must never self-discount
- Adjustments are immediately applied via addLineItemAdjustments, not deferred to cart.updated

Troubleshooting:
- "mode_config does not match bundle schema": mode_config shape must match the selected promotion_mode
- "Bundle mode requires the promotion type Amount off products": change the Medusa promotion type to "Amount off products" (fixed)
- Promotion not auto-applying: check auto_apply is true AND is_automatic is false on the Medusa promotion
- Adjustments disappear after cart update: expected -- the subscriber re-applies from cart_ext_adjustment table on every update

## [CONFIG]

PromotionExtConfig fields:
  promotion_id: string (required) — links to Medusa promotion.id
  auto_apply: boolean (default false) — enables Layer 2 auto-apply
  include_groups_combinator: "and"|"or" (default "or") — joins include groups
  exclude_groups_combinator: "and"|"or" (default "or") — joins exclude groups (draft)
  promotion_mode: "standard"|"bundle"|"buyget_repeat" (default "standard")
  mode_config: JSON (nullable) — shape depends on promotion_mode

Bundle mode_config:
  bundle_size: number (min 2) — items per bundle
  remainder: "full_price" — leftover items at full price

Buy-get repeat mode_config:
  buy_quantity: number (min 1) — items at full price per group
  get_quantity: number (min 1) — items discounted per group
  discount_target: "cheapest" — discount applies to cheapest items
  remainder: "full_price" — leftover items at full price

Reused application_method fields for non-standard modes:
  type: "fixed"|"percentage" — bundle requires "fixed"
  value: number — bundle price or discount amount/%
  max_quantity: number|null — bundle: max participating items; buy-get: max "buy" items

## [STRUCTURE]

src/admin/components/rules-editor/: Drawer-based rule editor with combinator toggles and group cards
src/admin/components/promotion-mode/: Promotion mode display (read-only) and edit form
src/admin/hooks/: React Query hooks for configs, rule groups, rules (CRUD + batch)
src/admin/widgets/promotion-rules-widget.tsx: Main widget injected at promotion.details.after
src/admin/lib/types.ts: Admin TypeScript types
src/api/admin/promotion-ext-configs/: Config REST routes, validators, mode validation
src/api/admin/promotion-ext-rule-groups/: Rule group REST routes and validators
src/api/admin/promotion-ext-rules/: Rule REST routes and validators
src/api/admin/cart-adjustments/: Manual cart adjustment CRUD per cart
src/lib/rule-evaluator.ts: Pure rule evaluation function (no DB, no side effects)
src/lib/cart-enricher.ts: Builds EnrichedCart context with order history
src/lib/adjustment-calculator.ts: Bundle and buy-get repeat computation
src/lib/target-rule-evaluator.ts: Filters eligible cart items by target rules
src/lib/adjustment-spread.ts: Proportional distribution of cart-wide adjustments
src/modules/promotion-ext/models/: MikroORM entities (4 tables)
src/modules/promotion-ext/service.ts: MedusaService with auto-generated CRUD
src/modules/promotion-ext/migrations/: DB migrations
src/subscribers/cart-updated.ts: Layer 2 auto-apply engine + adjustment computation
src/subscribers/validate-cart-promotions.ts: Layer 1 code gate
src/subscribers/validate-checkout.ts: Layer 3 checkout gate
src/subscribers/promotion-deleted.ts: Cascade cleanup on promotion deletion
src/types/: HTTP payload and response TypeScript types
src/workflows/promotion-ext/: Medusa workflows for CRUD operations
docs/metadata-promotion-enforcement/CONTEXT.md: Domain glossary
docs/metadata-promotion-enforcement/adr/: Architecture Decision Records (5 ADRs)

## [API]

POST   /admin/promotion-ext-configs — Create config { promotion_id, auto_apply?, promotion_mode?, mode_config? }
GET    /admin/promotion-ext-configs?promotion_id=X — List configs with nested groups and rules
PATCH  /admin/promotion-ext-configs/:id — Update config fields
DELETE /admin/promotion-ext-configs/:id — Delete config
POST   /admin/promotion-ext-configs/batch — Batch create configs
PATCH  /admin/promotion-ext-configs/batch — Batch update configs
DELETE /admin/promotion-ext-configs/batch — Batch delete configs

POST   /admin/promotion-ext-rule-groups — Create group { promotion_config_id, type, rules_combinator? }
GET    /admin/promotion-ext-rule-groups?promotion_config_id=X — List groups
PATCH  /admin/promotion-ext-rule-groups/:id — Update group
DELETE /admin/promotion-ext-rule-groups/:id — Delete group (cascades rules)
POST   /admin/promotion-ext-rule-groups/batch — Batch create
DELETE /admin/promotion-ext-rule-groups/batch — Batch delete

POST   /admin/promotion-ext-rules — Create rule { rule_group_id, rule_type, config }
GET    /admin/promotion-ext-rules?rule_group_id[]=X — List rules for groups
PATCH  /admin/promotion-ext-rules/:id — Update rule
DELETE /admin/promotion-ext-rules/:id — Delete rule
POST   /admin/promotion-ext-rules/batch — Batch create
PATCH  /admin/promotion-ext-rules/batch — Batch update
DELETE /admin/promotion-ext-rules/batch — Batch delete

POST   /admin/cart-adjustments/:cart_id — Create adjustment { amount, code?, item_id?, description? }
GET    /admin/cart-adjustments/:cart_id — List adjustments for cart
PATCH  /admin/cart-adjustments/:cart_id/:id — Update adjustment
DELETE /admin/cart-adjustments/:cart_id/:id — Delete adjustment
PATCH  /admin/cart-adjustments/:cart_id/batch — Batch update
DELETE /admin/cart-adjustments/:cart_id/batch — Batch delete
